gloss: re-entry (into a country); returning to a country after leaving

definitions.gloss: re-entry (into a country); returning to a country after leaving
definitions.explanation: Used in immigration and visa contexts, referring to the process of entering a country again after having left.

examples.japanese: {再入国|さいにゅうこく}⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: You need to obtain a re-entry permit.

examples.japanese: {再入国|さいにゅうこく}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}えます→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Re-entry procedures can be done at the airport.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{再入国|さいにゅうこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: Re-entry conditions differ depending on the type of visa.

notes:
Combines ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (again) and ⟦{入国|にゅうこく}→入国：15859_nyuukoku⟧ (entering a country). An important term for foreign residents of Japan who need to leave and return. Japan's immigration system distinguishes between {再入国許可|さいにゅうこくきょか} (re-entry permit) and the newer みなし{再入国|さいにゅうこく}⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧ (deemed re-entry permit) introduced in 2012.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再入国|さいにゅうこく}⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧: re-entry permit
- {再入国|さいにゅうこく}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: re-entry procedures
- {再入国|さいにゅうこく}⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧: re-entry visa
- みなし{再入国|さいにゅうこく}: deemed re-entry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入国|にゅうこく}→入国：15859_nyuukoku⟧: entering a country — the initial entry
- ⟦{出国|しゅっこく}→出国：15879_shukkoku⟧: leaving a country — departing a country
- ⟦{帰国|きこく}→帰国：03025_kikoku⟧: returning to one's home country — returning home specifically
